newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Berger changes chairman after takeover.
newsitem.headline: Berger changes chairman after takeover.

text.p: Paint company Berger International Ltd said on Monday its chairman, Vijay Mallya, had resigned with immediate effect and been replaced by Mohd Annuar.
The company said in a statement that Mohd Kamal, Abdul Ghani, Albert Saychuan Cheok, Josephine Premla Sivaretnam and Rizal Bin Ishak had all been appointed non-executive directors.
The changes follow the acquisition of Berger by Ariza Holdings, a company owned 33 percent by Kamal, 33 percent by Ghani and 34 percent by Cheok.
The statement also said A.K. Ravindranath Nedungadi had resigned as a director of Berger.
Ariza said on October 2 that, at the close of its general takeover offer for Berger, it owned 58.98 million shares or 56.8 percent of the company.
